answer.rationale: Latency spike began 90 minutes after the release deployment, strongly indicating a regression in the new build. memory_b1 confirms rollbacks have successfully resolved release-induced issues without customer impact. memory_b6 shows releases frequently contain regressions caught by canaries. With settlement traffic at peak, preserving write availability is paramount; rollback directly addresses the root cause while all other options only mitigate symptoms. Capacity (memory_b3) was pre-provisioned and is not the issue, failover (memory_b2) would not fix the code regression, and circuit breakers/read replicas (memory_b4, memory_b5) target different failure modes.
